title: What binds to what once a letter is in the way

ask.text: Let it settle and read it.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
The power binds to the socket alone. The collar is outside it.
The socket squared is 16. Only then does 3 come in.

worldFraming.text: This hatch was cut by somebody careful about what goes under a power.

ask.text: Let it settle and read it.

hints.text: One lock, several wards. Whatever the outside takes, every ward takes.
Nothing bundles the inversion in with the socket here. Look at what is inside the power.
The power reaches 9, and the inversion is still standing outside it.

worldFraming.text: The ward is bound tighter than the joins around it, and it lifts as one.
